summary: Socket option setup for an already-created socket. Branches on the optval parameter: when non-zero it calls setsockopt(s, 6, 1, &val, 4) then setsockopt(s, 0xFFFF, 8, &val, 4); when zero it calls setsockopt(s, 0xFFFF, 32, &val, 4). In both paths it then registers asynchronous network events with WSAAsyncSelect(v3, dword_8D3E28, 0x1A0A, 63) and returns 1. All setsockopt calls resolve through the imported thunk at 0x0059E308 and WSAAsyncSelect through the thunk at 0x0059E320. Called by sub_57DC10 (0057DC10) and NetworkConnectionThread (0057FC80).

local_names.optval: boolean selector deciding the keepalive path versus the broadcast path
local_names.v3: socket handle preserved across the calls (aliases s)

operations.description: Branches on the optval parameter: non-zero selects the two-call keepalive configuration path, zero selects the single-call broadcast configuration path
setsockopt(s, 6, 1, &val, 4) on the non-zero path, with val forced to 1; option set at level 6 (IPPROTO_TCP) via the imported thunk 0x0059E308
setsockopt(v3, 0xFFFF, 8, &val, 4) on the non-zero path, with val forced to 1; option set at level 0xFFFF (SOL_SOCKET) via the imported thunk 0x0059E308
setsockopt(s, 0xFFFF, 32, &val, 4) on the zero path, passing the optval variable itself as the option value; option set at level 0xFFFF (SOL_SOCKET) via the imported thunk 0x0059E308
WSAAsyncSelect(v3, dword_8D3E28, 0x1A0A, 63) registers asynchronous network events against the window handle stored at global 0x008D3E28, via the imported thunk 0x0059E320
Returns constant 1 on both paths, signalling setup success
Invoked by sub_57DC10 (0057DC10) and NetworkConnectionThread (0057FC80) as part of network connection setup
